The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
Symboli Rudolf displays her brilliant 
leadership in directing the event. 
However, perhaps due to fatigue, she was 
making uncharacteristically noticeable 
mistakes.

Even so, Symboli Rudolf ran in the race as 
part of fan service—an exhibition race.

Everyone expects a performance befitting 
the "Emperor." Symboli Rudolf took off 
from the gates to answer their calls, but 
the result was utterly disastrous.

Over the "Emperor's" blunder, the 
audience's murmurs did not subside for 
quite some time.
